messages:
alice.m: heads up — canary deploy for runtime v2026-03-20 failed provenance check in eu-west-1. deploybot flagged mismatch between attestation and mirror digest :frowning:
ben.r: ugh. CI pushed to GCR then mirroring to ECR. logs?
deploybot: DEPLOY HALT — ProvenanceVerificationError: manifest digest in attestation sha256:aa11.. != fetched ECR manifest digest sha256:bb22.. from eu-west-1 mirror. See /deploy/logs/1940345678
dana.k: quick note — our mirror job re-orders manifest list entries which can change manifest digest for multi-arch images. cosign attestation was signed on original GCR manifest digest.
infra-oncall: confirm: the image tag is runtime:v2026-03-20 (not a moving 'latest')?
alice.m: correct. tag is pinned in release notes to that semantic tag, but not pinned to digest in the deploy config. Canary uses tag -> pulls mirror.
ben.r: two options: 1) retag the original GCR digest and push to ECR with same manifest ordering so attestation matches, or 2) resign cosign attestations against the ECR mirror digest and reattach. opinion?
release-manager: we need a short change window to avoid user-facing issues. Can we avoid rollback? Canary already 0/5 success in eu-west-1.
ci-bot: build pipeline output: gcr manifest sha256:aa11deadbeef, ecr mirrored sha256:bb22feedface. mirror job used skopeo copy without --preserve-digests.
dana.k: if we retag+push the original digest into ECR under a new digest-equal manifest, we can update deploy config to pin to digest and resume canary quickly. Steps below.
ben.r: proposed commands:
```
# pull original manifest
skopeo inspect --raw docker://gcr.io/redwood/runtime:v2026-03-20 > manifest.json
# push exactly the same manifest to ecr (force ordering)
skopeo copy --raw-manifest manifest.json docker://123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/runtime@sha256:aa11deadbeef
cosign attach --key $COSIGN_KEY --signature attestation.json 123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/runtime@sha256:aa11deadbeef
```
infra-oncall: we may need ECR PutImage with platform entries to preserve ordering; skopeo should work but I'll pair-program with you.
alice.m: can we also update deploybot to accept a mapping table temporarily? I can open a quick PR to allow tag->digest override for canary only.
deploybot: suggestion accepted: temporary override route available via /deploy/overrides for canary; requires approver.
release-manager: ok. timeline? we need canary back within 30m or rollback to v2026-03-19.
ben.r: infra-oncall and I can do the retag + cosign reattach in ~15-20m. I'll coordinate.
infra-oncall: starting now. ping when done and I'll trigger canary resume.
alice.m: adding release notes line and bias to NOT change public docs until canary passes.
ben.r: done — pushed manifest and attached attestation. pasted new ECR digest sha256:aa11deadbeef (matches original).
infra-oncall: triggered deploybot resume for canary in eu-west-1.
deploybot: RESUME CANARY — runtime:v2026-03-20 pinned to sha256:aa11deadbeef in eu-west-1. Running 5 pod canary.
alice.m: :eyes: watching logs. so far 2/5 started, no runtime errors.
dana.k: note for postmortem — mirror pipeline should preserve manifest digests or publish attestation tied to mirrored digest. filing ticket INFRA-2287.
release-manager: recording in release notes: canary delayed 20m due to mirror manifest digest mismatch, fixed by retagging and reattaching attestation. No user-impact. Change window not extended.
ben.r: thanks everyone. follow-up: add digest pin to deploy configs for hotfixes. I'll create PR.
